component: plbert (CustomAlbert bidirectional encoder) full model = OptimizedMultichipDecoder + tied-embedding reconstruction readout
selection_summary: Fastest evaluated config that satisfies the full-model accuracy + last_hidden_state fidelity gate, ranked by trace-verified teacher-forcing decode t/s/u. This is the canonical BFP8/HiFi2 policy carried from stage 02, re-validated at the full-model level here. It is also the current dataclass default, and is now the file-backed default that build_generator loads.

thresholds.pcc_bar_rationale: Kokoro is a TTS model whose REAL output is last_hidden_state (it feeds the prosody predictor + ISTFTNet vocoder); the reconstruction top-1/5/100 is a derived MLM proxy. last_hidden_state PCC>=0.995 vs HF is the model-specific output-fidelity bar carried unchanged from stages 01-06 and is applied here in addition to the skill's top-1>=90% / top-5>=98% bars.

construct._note: These are the EXACT constructor kwargs consumed by tt/precision_config.load_selected -> PrecisionPolicy(**policy), OptConfig(**opt). build_generator loads this by default (proven by doc/datatype_sweep/propagation_check.json).

layernorm_weights.note: norms are cheap; HiFi4 + fp32 dest acc kept for accuracy

readout_lm_head.note: the reconstruction readout (LM-head analog); logits are bf16

layer_exceptions: None. plbert is 12 weight-tied AlbertLayers (one shared weight set), so there is a single layer policy and no per-layer/first-last exception. First/last-layer BFP4 exclusion is moot because no BFP4 group is selected.

compute_fidelities.note: fp32 dest accumulation is REQUIRED for BFP8-weight short-length PCC (stage 02: fp32acc=false drops T=16 prefill PCC to 0.9909); costs ~0.3% latency, kept.

activation_residual_dtype.note: bf16 activations are MANDATORY: ttnn SDPA rejects fp32 inputs, so the functional stage's fp32 activations cannot be carried forward.

ccl_dtype.note: Per-layer collectives (1 all_gather residual->full-seq feeding QKV; 1 reduce_scatter WO-partial->residual shard). BFP8 CCL was swept: reduce_scatter in BFP8 erodes last_hidden_state PCC below 0.995 (ccl_bfp8 pcc=0.9896) and is slower at T=128; all_gather-only BFP8 passes (ccl_ag_bfp8 pcc=0.9981) but is slower on the ranking metric (traced TF decode 341.1 < baseline 347.8). bf16 CCL selected.

kv_cache_dtype.rationale: Kokoro's plbert is a non-autoregressive, bidirectional, stateless encoder: no KV cache, no paged cache, no current-position state. 'decode' is a stateless full-sequence traced re-encode (decode == prefill). No KV-cache dtype axis exists, and no candidate changes memory capacity via a KV cache. See doc/context_contract.json.

logits_sampling_dtype.logits: bf16 (bfloat16) from the reconstruction readout matmul
logits_sampling_dtype.sampling: greedy on-device ttnn.argmax over bf16 logits (bit-exact greedy token); no probability distribution / temperature / top-k in the real TTS path
logits_sampling_dtype.note: MoE routing / router-logits dtype: N/A (no MoE). Sampler comparison and the rejected Sampling1D/TTTv2 top-k/top-p paths are recorded in doc/full_model/sampler_comparison.json.

context_contract.note: Selected KV-cache dtype is N/A (0 bytes), so context capacity is unchanged. See doc/context_contract.json -> datatype_sweep.

non_aligned_prompt_support.note: Selected config uses the baseline dtype/layout, so chunking/padding is unchanged. Non-aligned lengths 31/33/127/200/511 validated at last_hidden_state PCC>=0.995 for the selected config (see propagation / candidates/baseline.json pcc_non_aligned and doc/datatype_sweep/non_aligned_check.json).

override_to_safe_baseline: Delete this file (build_generator falls back to PrecisionPolicy()/OptConfig() dataclass defaults, which equal this config), or pass policy=/opt= explicitly to build_generator / build_kwargs.
consumed_by: models/demos/audio/kokoro/tt/generator.py::build_generator (default when policy/opt not passed, via tt/precision_config.load_selected)
